name: Apartbauernhof Valrunzhof
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apartbauernhof Valrunzhof is nestled in a peaceful, rural setting in Tirol. The self-catering apartments come equipped with a kitchen and living area. The farm includes animals and agricultural land that define the operation. Guests can purchase regional products directly from the farm. In the area, summer hiking and winter sports are both available. The farm is run by a family and is ideal for families and couples. The farming methods follow traditional practices.
